name: model-chip-follows-the-echoed-name
description: With the model left on "default", the model chip shows whatever name the harness echoes in its init, and follows it when a later init reports a different model. The "Session started" line is still logged once.
reason: "default" says nothing about which model is actually answering. The chip used to read a value that only refreshed on the next turn, so it showed stale information (v1.3 C).
source: DESIGN.md v1.3 C 'Chip display rules' and v2.0 'harnessReportedModel exposes the active adapter's model for the chip'; AppState.modelChipLabel / harnessReportedModel

script.reason: Launching: nothing has been echoed yet.
The CLI's system/init names the model it picked.
A later system/init in the same session reports another model (the CLI emits one after a model switch).
